verdict.rationale: Antigravity's agent can operate autonomously across the editor, terminal, and browser. It can delegate test runs and extensive codebase searches to subagents, and it produces artifacts such as browser recordings and code diffs. Together these imply it can reproduce bugs, search for causes, and verify fixes by running tests. However, no evidence describes a dedicated debugging, bug-reproduction, or root-cause workflow, so the story is only inferred from general agent capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit docs on reproducing issues and root-cause analysis, debugger/breakpoint or log-inspection support, a documented fix-verification loop, and independent hands-on corroboration of debugging use.
